outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a schematic of breast anatomy and a classification table with frequency percentages; it is not a plot showing averaged individual measurements, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the study aim, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental setup for luciferase recordings, not a data plot.

Panel D is a schematic workflow illustrating quantification approaches, with idealized example traces (Model #1-3) used for illustration rather than presenting actual averaged data with error bars, so it is not a plot requiring individual points.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since individual points are not meaningful in this visualization.
Panel F is a schematic of the live-imaging workflow with an idealized illustrative growth curve example, not a plot of real averaged experimental data.
Panel G is a schematic of the drug-treatment workflow with an idealized illustrative dose-response curve example, not a plot of real averaged experimental data.
Panel H is a schematic of the genomic analysis workflow with illustrative example heatmap/mutation grids, not an actual data plot.
Panel I shows scatter plots (PCA cluster and 3D parameter scatter); scatter plots inherently display individual data points, so this exemption applies.
